src/store/playerStore.ts.description: Player store now includes showPlayerNames state and setPlayerName/togglePlayerNames actions for the player name labels feature

src/components/Scene/Player.tsx.description: Player component now renders 3D Text labels from @react-three/drei above players. Labels are conditionally rendered based on showPlayerNames state and player.playerName field.

src/components/UI/Toolbar.tsx.description: Edit Player Name dialog added - appears when clicking an already-selected player. Uses editingPlayerId from playerStore to track which player is being edited. Supports Enter to save and Escape to cancel.
